default_invocation.description: Use a self-contained compact assignment by default. Task-packet JSON is not required unless Maestro explicitly requests machine-readable audit continuity.
default_invocation.expected_return: Concise audit verdict with findings, required revisions, residual risks, and recommended next action.

machine_readable_invocation.use_when: Maestro explicitly requests machine-readable audit continuity, or the audit affects gate readiness.

handoff_json.use_when: Maestro explicitly requests machine-readable audit continuity, or the audit affects gate readiness.
